prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1294; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'd rather keep my name off this one, if that's all right. You can just call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Pearland, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the store entrance when another vehicle came down the aisle and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: I was rolling backward slowly, maybe five miles an hour. The other driver was coming through fast, or at least it felt that way to me.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until right before. A cart corral was blocking my view on the left side. I heard a horn and then felt the jolt.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the time?

A: Not right away. I got out, looked at the damage, and kept saying I was fine. By that evening my lower back was really tight, and by the next morning I had sharp pain when I bent over. I was diagnosed with a back strain and I've been doing physical therapy since.

Q: Have you been seeing a doctor for this?

A: Yes, my primary care physician referred me to a physical therapist. I've missed about a week of work because of it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the parking lot rules and I'm hoping this gets sorted out fairly. I can send over my medical records and the photos I took at the scene.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
